title: CROSSJOIN returns every combination of the rows of its tables
query: EVALUATE CROSSJOIN ( VALUES ( Product[Category] ), VALUES ( Customer[Country] ) )

source.quote: The total number of rows returned by CROSSJOIN() is equal to the product of the number of rows from all tables in the arguments

derivation: 2 categories times 3 countries = 6 rows, with one column from each table.
